analysis_reasoning: MCTS Round 1 (root expansion). Golden is a triple-nested PyTorch loop (N x HV x NT chunks of small fp32 matmuls) -> massive latency headroom; target 5x vs this loop baseline is reachable with a single fused kernel. Operator family = chunked gated delta rule fwd_h: v_new = u - w@S_prev; S_next = exp(g_last)*S_prev + k^T@(v_new*exp(g_last-g)). CRITICAL precision finding (validated empirically on ascend910b3 this round): (1) CANN fp32 matmul is true fp32 (hf32/bf16-truncated dots violate tolerance by ~1M/4M elements); (2) Triton tl.dot(..., input_precision='ieee') with fp32 operands reproduces the NPU golden EXACTLY incl. the +Inf overflow mask (golden itself overflows v_new to +Inf on 37k+/4M positions under the relaxed N(1,1) input distribution - verify requires Inf position+sign match); (3) masked-out rows must contribute exactly 0 to the k^T@u dot (k loads masked to 0). Design: one fused kernel, grid=(B*HV*num_vt) [x num_seqs for varlen], serial per-chunk loop, S=[K,BV] fp32 in registers, BLOCK_L=chunk_size (no sub-block loop - 2nd-iteration misread hazard), w/k/u loaded fp32-cast, two ieee dots per chunk, g per-chunk scalars via masked max-position load, S stored bf16 per chunk (pre-update state), v_new stored bf16.
